name: Pokepvp
description: Black Gold Card Arena: a creature-card NFT that mines $PVP on BNB Smart Chain. Mint a node — five editions priced in BNB — and it accrues $PVP per second from the block it lands. Eras halve the yield (30 days or 150,000 hash rate minted per era, up to 11 eras).
tierModel: Edition set by the price paid — never random. Paid mints unlimited per wallet (1 NFT per transaction); Starter free mint is 1 per wallet.

tiers.name: Bronze
tiers.priceNote: Exact fixed BNB — the contract requires this amount precisely

tiers.name: Silver
tiers.priceNote: Exact fixed BNB — the contract requires this amount precisely

tiers.name: Gold
tiers.priceNote: Exact fixed BNB — the contract requires this amount precisely

tiers.name: Diamond
tiers.priceNote: Exact fixed BNB — the contract requires this amount precisely

priceOracle: None — prices are fixed in the contract in BNB; send the exact amount or the mint reverts.

token.name: Pokepvp Token
token.claims: claim(tokenId) on the NFT contract — any time, no fee, no deadline; accrued yield follows the token when it is transferred.

epochs.label: Eras
epochs.endCondition: 30 days OR 150,000 hash rate minted inside the era — whichever comes first
epochs.shareEquals: 1 share = 1 $PVP/day of hash rate minted inside the era
epochs.halving: Reward halves at every era boundary (Era 1 = 100%, Era 2 = 50%, Era 3 = 25%, ...). Accrued $PVP is never reduced.

gate: None — open minting for any wallet. The Starter edition additionally requires that the wallet has not used its free mint (freeUsed).
deploymentStatus: Contracts built and verified locally end-to-end (32 of 32 checks). contractAddress and tokenAddress are filled into this manifest at deployment.

checks: the value sent equals editionPrice(edition) exactly

abisNote: Read surface: name(), symbol() = PKVP, mintOpen(), MAX_SUPPLY() = 10000, totalMinted(), editionPrice(uint256), hashRateOf(uint256), pendingOf(uint256), era(), eraShares(), eraStarts(uint256), totalHashRate(), tokensOfOwner(address), freeUsed(address), pvpToken(); writes: mint(uint8) payable, claim(uint256).
